POST /places.summary: returns place information for a given place request

POST /trips-collection.summary: returns a collection of trips for a given OJP trip request

POST /trips.summary: Returns a new trip for given OJP parameters based on an already existing trip

GET /trips/{tripId}.summary: Returns a trip element representing a travel trip.

POST /offers.summary: Returns offers for trips or trip search criteria.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Get additional offers of booked offer for a given booking.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{pa.summary: Returns the passenger's information at booking step.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{.summary: Allows updating a passenger's information at booking step.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Returns the purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows creating a purchaser for a booking already existing.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows updating a purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Creates bookedOffers from offers and adds them in a booking.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Gets a bookedOffer of a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Delete a bookedOffer from a booking.
Delete a passenger from bookedOffer of a booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds a reservation to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes a reservation from a booking in case the reservation was not yet confirmed.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds an ancillary to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes an ancillary from a booking in case the ancillary is not jet confirmed.
Removes an admission from a booking.

POST /bookings.summary: Creates a booking based on a previously requested offer.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}.summary: Updates a booking but does *not* confirm the booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/cleanup.summary: Performs a complete cleanup of a booking in a single step

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/history.summary: Returns the history of changes to a booking.

POST /bookings-search.summary: Search for bookings based on search parameters.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/split.summary: Split a booking into multiple bookings.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Confirms the booking a triggers the fulfillment of the booking synchronously or asynchronously.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Optionally finalizes the fulfillments in asynchronous mode.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers.summary: Initiates a refund process by creating a refundOffer resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers/.summary: Returns the refund offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offer.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a refund offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offe.summary: Deletes a refundOffer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offer.summary: Initiates a release process by creating a releaseOffers resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offers.summary: Returns the release offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offe.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a release offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/release-off.summary: Deletes a release offer without waiting for expiry.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfill.summary: Returns the cancel fulfillments offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfi.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a cancel fulfillments offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulf.summary: Deletes a cancel fulfillments offer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-offe.summary: Returns exchange offers for specified fulfillments

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-oper.summary: Pre-books an exchangeOffer as part of an exchange operation.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-opera.summary: Returns the exchange operation with the id provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-ope.summary: Allows to update an ongoing exchange operation.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-op.summary: Cancels an ongoing exchange operation in provisional state.

GET /coach-layouts/{layoutId}.summary: Returns a coach layout for a provided id.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/documents.summary: Allows adding a document to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/documents/{.summary: Delete a document from a booking.

POST /availabilities/place-map.summary: Get multiple place maps including availabilities.

GET /availabilities/nearby.summary: Get availabilities nearby a given place.

GET /availabilities/preferences.summary: Get availabilities for a set of preferences.

GET /products/{productId}.summary: Returns a product for the provided id.

POST /places.summary: returns place information for a given place request

POST /trips-collection.summary: returns a collection of trips for a given OJP trip request

POST /trips.summary: Returns a new trip for given OJP parameters based on an already existing trip

GET /trips/{tripId}.summary: Returns a trip element representing a travel trip.

POST /offers.summary: Returns offers for trips or trip search criteria.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Get additional offers of booked offer for a given booking.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{pa.summary: Returns the passenger's information at booking step.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{.summary: Allows updating a passenger's information at booking step.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Returns the purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows creating a purchaser for a booking already existing.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows updating a purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Creates bookedOffers from offers and adds them in a booking.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Gets a bookedOffer of a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Delete a bookedOffer from a booking.
Delete a passenger from bookedOffer of a booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds a reservation to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes a reservation from a booking in case the reservation was not yet confirmed.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds an ancillary to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes an ancillary from a booking in case the ancillary is not jet confirmed.
Removes an admission from a booking.

POST /bookings.summary: Creates a booking based on a previously requested offer.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}.summary: Updates a booking but does *not* confirm the booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/cleanup.summary: Performs a complete cleanup of a booking in a single step

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/history.summary: Returns the history of changes to a booking.

POST /bookings-search.summary: Search for bookings based on search parameters.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/split.summary: Split a booking into multiple bookings.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Confirms the booking a triggers the fulfillment of the booking synchronously or asynchronously.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Optionally finalizes the fulfillments in asynchronous mode.

GET /fulfillments/{fulfillmentId}/contin.summary: return the continuous service usage including latest updates

PATCH /fulfillments/{fulfillmentId}/cont.summary: start or end the usage of a continuous service of an demand vehicle

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers.summary: Initiates a refund process by creating a refundOffer resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers/.summary: Returns the refund offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offer.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a refund offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offe.summary: Deletes a refundOffer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offer.summary: Initiates a release process by creating a releaseOffers resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offers.summary: Returns the release offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offe.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a release offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/release-off.summary: Deletes a release offer without waiting for expiry.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfill.summary: Returns the cancel fulfillments offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfi.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a cancel fulfillments offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulf.summary: Deletes a cancel fulfillments offer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-offe.summary: Returns exchange offers for specified fulfillments

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-oper.summary: Pre-books an exchangeOffer as part of an exchange operation.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-opera.summary: Returns the exchange operation with the id provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-ope.summary: Allows to update an ongoing exchange operation.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-op.summary: Cancels an ongoing exchange operation in provisional state.

GET /coach-deck-layouts/{layoutId}.summary: Returns a coach deck layout for a provided id.

GET /coach-layouts/{layoutId}.summary: Returns a coach layout for a provided id.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/documents.summary: Allows adding a document to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/documents/{.summary: Delete a document from a booking.

POST /availabilities/vehicle-place-map.summary: Get a place map for a requested vehicle including availabilities.

POST /availabilities/place-map.summary: Get multiple place maps including availabilities.

GET /availabilities/nearby.summary: Get availabilities nearby a given place.

GET /availabilities/preferences.summary: Get availabilities for a set of preferences.

POST /availabilities/on-demand-services.summary: Get availabilities of an on-demand service.

GET /products/{productId}.summary: Returns a product for the provided id.

GET /product-tags.summary: Returns all product tags and their grouping.

POST /products-search.summary: Search for products based on search parameters.

GET /versions.summary: Returns all available versions of the OSDM API.

POST /places.summary: returns place information for a given place request

POST /trips-collection.summary: returns a collection of trips for a given OJP trip request

POST /trips.summary: Returns a new trip for given OJP parameters based on an already existing trip

GET /trips/{tripId}.summary: Returns a trip element representing a travel trip.

POST /offers.summary: Returns offers for trips or trip search criteria.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Get additional offers of booked offer for a given booking.

POST /offer-overview-route.summary: Returns an overview of prices based on route

POST /offer-overview-trip.summary: Returns an overview of prices based on trips

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{pa.summary: Returns the passenger's information at booking step.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{.summary: Allows updating a passenger's information at booking step.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Returns the purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows creating a purchaser for a booking already existing.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows updating a purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Creates bookedOffers from offers and adds them in a booking.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Gets a bookedOffer of a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Delete a bookedOffer from a booking.
Delete a passenger from bookedOffer of a booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds a reservation to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes a reservation from a booking in case the reservation was not yet confirmed.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds an ancillary to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes an ancillary from a booking in case the ancillary is not jet confirmed.
Removes an admission from a booking.

POST /bookings.summary: Creates a booking based on a previously requested offer.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}.summary: Updates a booking but does *not* confirm the booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/cleanup.summary: Performs a complete cleanup of a booking in a single step

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/history.summary: Returns the history of changes to a booking.

POST /bookings-search.summary: Search for bookings based on search parameters.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/split.summary: Split a booking into multiple bookings.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Confirms the booking a triggers the fulfillment of the booking synchronously or asynchronously.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Optionally finalizes the fulfillments in asynchronous mode.

GET /fulfillments/{fulfillmentId}/contin.summary: return the continuous service usage including latest updates

PATCH /fulfillments/{fulfillmentId}/cont.summary: start or end the usage of a continuous service of an demand vehicle

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers.summary: Initiates a refund process by creating a refundOffer resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers/.summary: Returns the refund offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offer.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a refund offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offe.summary: Deletes a refundOffer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offer.summary: Initiates a release process by creating a releaseOffers resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offers.summary: Returns the release offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offe.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a release offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/release-off.summary: Deletes a release offer without waiting for expiry.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfill.summary: Returns the cancel fulfillments offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfi.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a cancel fulfillments offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulf.summary: Deletes a cancel fulfillments offer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-offe.summary: Returns exchange offers for specified fulfillments

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-oper.summary: Pre-books an exchangeOffer as part of an exchange operation.

GET /versions.summary: Returns all available versions of the OSDM API.

POST /places.summary: returns place information for a given place request

POST /trips-collection.summary: returns a collection of trips for a given OJP trip request

POST /trips.summary: Returns a new trip for given OJP parameters based on an already existing trip

GET /trips/{tripId}.summary: Returns a trip element representing a travel trip.

POST /offers.summary: Returns offers for trips or trip search criteria.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Get additional offers of booked offer for a given booking.

POST /offer-overview-route.summary: Returns an overview of prices based on route

POST /offer-overview-trip.summary: Returns an overview of prices based on trips

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{pa.summary: Returns the passenger's information at booking step.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{.summary: Allows updating a passenger's information at booking step.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers.summary: Returns all the passenger's in the booking.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers.summary: Allows updating a set of passengers in a batch at booking step.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Returns the purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows creating a purchaser for a booking already existing.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows updating a purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Creates bookedOffers from offers and adds them in a booking.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Gets a bookedOffer of a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Delete a bookedOffer from a booking.
Delete a passenger from bookedOffer of a booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds a reservation or ancillary not previously added from offer to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes reservations or ancillaries from a booking in case the parts were not yet confirmed.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds a reservation not previously added from offer to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes a reservation from a booking in case the reservation was not yet confirmed.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds an ancillary not previously added from offer to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes an ancillary from a booking in case the ancillary is not jet confirmed.
Removes an admission from a booking.

POST /bookings.summary: Creates a booking based on a previously requested offer.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}.summary: Updates a booking but does *not* confirm the booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/cleanup.summary: Performs a complete cleanup of a booking in a single step

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/history.summary: Returns the history of changes to a booking.

POST /bookings-search.summary: Search for bookings based on search parameters.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/split.summary: Split a booking into multiple bookings.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Confirms the booking a triggers the fulfillment of the booking synchronously or asynchronously.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Optionally finalizes the fulfillments in asynchronous mode.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillment-ch.summary: Verification step (step 1 in a two phase commit process) to run before the effective fulfillment endpoint.

GET /fulfillments/{fulfillmentId}/contin.summary: return the continuous service usage including latest updates

PATCH /fulfillments/{fulfillmentId}/cont.summary: start or end the usage of a continuous service of an demand vehicle

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers.summary: Initiates a refund process by creating a refundOffer resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers/.summary: Validation step (step 1 in a two phase commit process) to run before the effective patch endpoint.
Returns the refund offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offer.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a refund offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offe.summary: Deletes a refundOffer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offer.summary: Initiates a release process by creating a releaseOffers resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offers.summary: Returns the release offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offe.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a release offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/release-off.summary: Deletes a release offer without waiting for expiry.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfill.summary: Returns the cancel fulfillments offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfi.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a cancel fulfillments offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulf.summary: Deletes a cancel fulfillments offer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-offe.summary: Returns exchange offers for specified fulfillments

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-oper.summary: Pre-books an exchangeOffer as part of an exchange operation.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-opera.summary: Returns the exchange operation with the id provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-ope.summary: Allows to update an ongoing exchange operation.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-op.summary: Cancels an ongoing exchange operation in provisional state.

GET /coach-deck-layouts/{layoutId}.summary: Returns a coach deck layout for a provided id.

GET /coach-layouts/{layoutId}.summary: Returns a coach layout for a provided id.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/documents.summary: Allows adding a document to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/documents/{.summary: Delete a document from a booking.

POST /availabilities/vehicle-place-map.summary: Get a place map for a requested vehicle including availabilities.

POST /availabilities/place-map.summary: Get multiple place maps including availabilities.

GET /availabilities/nearby.summary: Get availabilities nearby a given place.

GET /availabilities/preferences.summary: Get availabilities for a set of preferences.

POST /availabilities/on-demand-services.summary: Get availabilities of an on-demand service.

GET /products/{productId}.summary: Returns a product for the provided id.

GET /product-tags.summary: Returns all product tags and their grouping.

POST /products-search.summary: Search for products based on search parameters.

GET /versions.summary: Returns all available versions of the OSDM API.

POST /places.summary: returns place information for a given place request

POST /trips-collection.summary: returns a collection of trips for a given OJP trip request

POST /trips.summary: Returns a new trip for given OJP parameters based on an already existing trip

GET /trips/{tripId}.summary: Returns a trip element representing a travel trip.

POST /offers.summary: Returns offers for trips or trip search criteria.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Get additional offers of booked offer for a given booking.

POST /offer-overview-route.summary: Returns an overview of prices based on route

POST /offer-overview-trip.summary: Returns an overview of prices based on trips

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{pa.summary: Returns the passenger's information at booking step.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers/{.summary: Allows updating a passenger's information at booking step.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers.summary: Returns all the passenger's in the booking.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/passengers.summary: Allows updating a set of passengers in a batch at booking step.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Returns the purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows creating a purchaser for a booking already existing.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/purchaser.summary: Allows updating a purchaser's information at booking step.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Creates bookedOffers from offers and adds them in a booking.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers/.summary: Gets a bookedOffer of a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Delete a bookedOffer from a booking.
Delete a passenger from bookedOffer of a booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds a reservation or ancillary not previously added from offer to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes reservations or ancillaries from a booking in case the parts were not yet confirmed.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds a reservation not previously added from offer to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes a reservation from a booking in case the reservation was not yet confirmed.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offers.summary: Adds an ancillary not previously added from offer to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/booked-offe.summary: Removes an ancillary from a booking in case the ancillary is not jet confirmed.
Removes an admission from a booking.

POST /bookings.summary: Creates a booking based on a previously requested offer.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}.summary: Updates a booking but does *not* confirm the booking.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/cleanup.summary: Performs a complete cleanup of a booking in a single step

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/history.summary: Returns the history of changes to a booking.

POST /bookings-search.summary: Search for bookings based on search parameters.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/split.summary: Split a booking into multiple bookings.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Confirms the booking a triggers the fulfillment of the booking synchronously or asynchronously.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillments.summary: Optionally finalizes the fulfillments in asynchronous mode.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/fulfillment-ch.summary: Verification step (step 1 in a two phase commit process) to run before the effective fulfillment endpoint.

GET /fulfillments/{fulfillmentId}/contin.summary: return the continuous service usage including latest updates

PATCH /fulfillments/{fulfillmentId}/cont.summary: start or end the usage of a continuous service of an demand vehicle

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers.summary: Initiates a refund process by creating a refundOffer resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offers/.summary: Validation step (step 1 in a two phase commit process) to run before the effective patch endpoint.
Returns the refund offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offer.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a refund offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/refund-offe.summary: Deletes a refundOffer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offer.summary: Initiates a release process by creating a releaseOffers resource.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offers.summary: Returns the release offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/release-offe.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a release offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/release-off.summary: Deletes a release offer without waiting for expiry.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfill.summary: Returns the cancel fulfillments offer for the ids provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulfi.summary: Allows to accept and confirm a cancel fulfillments offer.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-fulf.summary: Deletes a cancel fulfillments offer without waiting for expiry.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-offe.summary: Returns exchange offers for specified fulfillments

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-oper.summary: Pre-books an exchangeOffer as part of an exchange operation.

GET /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-opera.summary: Returns the exchange operation with the id provided.

PATCH /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-ope.summary: Allows to update an ongoing exchange operation.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/exchange-op.summary: Cancels an ongoing exchange operation in provisional state.

GET /coach-deck-layouts/{layoutId}.summary: Returns a coach deck layout for a provided id.

GET /coach-layouts/{layoutId}.summary: Returns a coach layout for a provided id.

POST /bookings/{bookingId}/documents.summary: Allows adding a document to a booking.

DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}/documents/{.summary: Delete a document from a booking.

POST /availabilities/vehicle-place-map.summary: Get a place map for a requested vehicle including availabilities.

POST /availabilities/place-map.summary: Get multiple place maps including availabilities.

GET /availabilities/nearby.summary: Get availabilities nearby a given place.

GET /availabilities/preferences.summary: Get availabilities for a set of preferences.

POST /availabilities/on-demand-services.summary: Get availabilities of an on-demand service.

GET /products/{productId}.summary: Returns a product for the provided id.

GET /product-tags.summary: Returns all product tags and their grouping.

POST /products-search.summary: Search for products based on search parameters.
